description: Parse a JSON wire document back into a portlet collection and report the reconstructed domain state. The input payload is a JSON string in the canonical wire form (a 'portlet' array of objects keyed by 'portlet-name', 'portlet-class', and 'init-param'). The parser must rebuild each portlet record, exposing its identifier, its implementation class, and its initialization parameters as a name-to-value mapping. The reconstructed state is printed as a deterministic dump: the number of portlets, then for each portlet (in document order) its identifier, class, parameter count, and each parameter as a 'init.<name>=<value>' line with parameter names in ascending order.

cases.expected_output:
portlets=1
[0] id=categories
[0] class=com.liferay.portlet.StrutsPortlet
[0] init_count=2
[0] init.param2=param2.value
[0] init.view-action=/ext/c
